dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Thin, low-contrast pale fringes visible on the posterior edges of the folded tertials against a darker grey-brown base color.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Two symmetrical, elongated elliptical orange-brown patches positioned on the lateral regions of the crown and upper nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse and non-linear transition with low contrast between the grey crown and the grey-brown mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent transverse black and white barring on the visible portion of the tail feathers.
